# About

This repository contains all project files and source code featured on the Bigelow Inventions YouTube channel, plus additional tutorials and resources for makers and coders.

## 📂 Structure

- **Projects/** – Main project files
- **Tutorials/** – Step-by-step guides and code samples
	- JavaScript, Python, and more

## 🚀 Get Involved

Feel free to explore, fork, and contribute! For questions or collaboration, reach out via any of the social links above.
